_readme: Decoded silence measurements for voiceover.mp3, from:
These are MEASURED BY DECODING, not read from synthesis metadata (bug-ledger entry 5).
They exist because voice.mjs solves the gap from msedge-tts word-boundary metadata, and
that metadata reported a 0 ms tail on all 8 clips — which the decoder disproves.
write-script.mjs reads this file so script.md reports measured values rather than targets
(SKILL.md §6). Re-run the scan and replace this file after any change at S3 or S4.
scannedAfter: review round 3 — loop reframed as a win, dimensions counts rounded
method: OfflineAudioContext decode, 20 ms RMS window, threshold 0.004, runs >= 400 ms

perceivedGaps._note: voice.mjs solved for 1500 ms using a metadata tail of 0 ms. The decoder puts the real tail at roughly 335 ms, which matches the ~276-312 ms the pipeline contract documents. The gaps are uniform and correct relative to each other; they are simply ~335 ms longer than asked for. Recovering it needs either perceivedGapMs lowered to ~1165, or a decode-based tail measurement in voice.mjs.

intraSegmentPauses._note: Natural sentence breaks inside a segment, not gap-solve output. The count varies by +/-1 between runs because a ~400 ms pause sits exactly on the detector's 400 ms floor and quantises differently across the 20 ms RMS grid once the timeline shifts. Not an audio change.
